# @dschz/solid-flow — agent cheatsheet

SolidJS port of React Flow / Svelte Flow (node-based UIs), built for SolidJS 2.0
(solid-js@2.0.0-rc.x; install with the `next` tag). Same gesture engine as
upstream (@xyflow/system), different state model.

```tsx
import { SolidFlow, createNodeStore, createEdgeStore } from "@dschz/solid-flow";
import "@dschz/solid-flow/styles"; // required, import once
```

## Unlearn these (React Flow priors that are WRONG here)

- NO `onNodesChange` / `onEdgesChange` / `applyNodeChanges` / `applyEdgeChanges` — state is store-based; mutate your store.
- NO `useReactFlow` — it is `useSolidFlow()`, called INSIDE `<SolidFlow>` (or under `<SolidFlowProvider>`).
- Events are pointer-named: `onNodePointerEnter`, not `onNodeMouseEnter` (same for edges/pane).
- Components run once (Solid): no re-renders, no dependency arrays; read reactive values in JSX/computations, not component-body statements.
- `createOptimisticStore` as `nodes`/`edges` IS supported (optimistic adds render mid-action; flow state survives reverts/reconciles). Draft-then-commit remains the simpler default — see "Saving to a server".

## Creating nodes/edges

```tsx
const [nodes, setNodes] = createNodeStore([
  { id: "1", type: "input", data: { label: "In" }, position: { x: 250, y: 0 } },
  { id: "2", data: { label: "Mid" }, position: { x: 100, y: 100 } }, // type defaults to "default"
]);
const [edges, setEdges] = createEdgeStore([{ id: "e1-2", source: "1", target: "2" }]);

// Mutations are drafts — O(changed), no spread ceremony:
setNodes((draft) => { draft[0]!.position.x += 20; });
setEdges((draft) => draft.filter((e) => e.id !== "e1-2")); // returning a new array replaces
```

Async creation (load from a server) — pass a function instead of an array:

```tsx
const [nodes] = createNodeStore(async () => (await fetch("/api/nodes")).json());
// Reads are not-ready until the data lands; optionally wrap the flow:
<Loading fallback={<Spinner />}>...</Loading> // from @solidjs/web

// LIVE graphs: an async generator streams updates (pair with live()):
const [liveNodes] = createNodeStore(async function* () {
  for await (const state of graphStream()) yield state.nodes;
});
```

## Custom node types (type-safe data)

```tsx
const CounterNode = (props: NodeProps<{ count: number }, "counter">) => (
  <div>
    <Handle type="target" position={Position.Top} />
    count: {props.data.count}
    <Handle type="source" position={Position.Bottom} />
  </div>
);
const nodeTypes = { counter: CounterNode } satisfies NodeTypes;

const [nodes] = createNodeStore<typeof nodeTypes>([
  { id: "a", type: "counter", data: { count: 1 }, position: { x: 0, y: 0 } }, // data narrowed by type
  { id: "b", type: "default", data: { label: "hi" }, position: { x: 0, y: 100 } }, // built-ins still work
  // { type: "countr", ... }  <- compile error: unknown type name
]);

<SolidFlow nodes={nodes} nodeTypes={nodeTypes} />;
```

Standalone typing for plain arrays/props: `satisfies SolidFlowNode<typeof nodeTypes>[]` (and `SolidFlowEdge`).

## Controlled vs uncontrolled (per axis)

- `nodes={store}` / `edges={store}` — CONTROLLED: your store owns membership; the flow writes runtime fields (`position`, `selected`, `measured`) onto your rows. Completed connections are NEVER auto-inserted (no adoption = no edge) — adopt in onConnect; commands (addNodes/addEdges) write through best-effort but do not survive your wholesale replacements:

```tsx
const onConnect = (c: EdgeConnection) => setEdges((draft) => { draft.push(c); });
<SolidFlow nodes={nodes} edges={edges} onConnect={onConnect} fitView />
```

- `defaultNodes={[...]}` / `defaultEdges={[...]}` — UNCONTROLLED: seeds once (sync or async source), then the flow owns membership; commands and completed connections write it directly; later prop changes are ignored.

## Reading & writing flow state

```tsx
const { flow, commands } = useSolidFlow(); // inside <SolidFlow> only
flow.nodes; flow.edges; flow.selection.nodes; flow.viewport; // reactive reads
```

Commands: `fitView`, `fitBounds`, `zoomIn`, `zoomOut`, `setZoom`, `setCenter`,
`setViewport`, `panBy`, `screenToFlowPosition`, `flowToScreenPosition`,
`addNodes`, `addEdges`, `setNodes`, `setEdges`, `updateNode`, `updateNodeData`,
`updateEdge`, `deleteElements`, `getIntersectingNodes`, `isNodeIntersecting`,
`getNodesBounds`, `updateNodeInternals`, `toObject`.

Hooks: `useNode(id)`, `useEdge(id)`, `useNodes()`, `useEdges()`,
`useSelectedNodes()`, `useSelectedEdges()`, `useNodeConnections()`,
`useKeyPress(keys)` — Accessor-based.

## Events (props on `<SolidFlow>`)

- Nodes: `onNodeClick`, `onNodeDoubleClick`, `onNodeContextMenu`, `onNodeDrag(Start|Stop)?`, `onNodePointer(Enter|Move|Leave)`
- Edges: `onEdgeClick`, `onEdgeDoubleClick`, `onEdgeContextMenu`, `onEdgePointer(Enter|Move|Leave)`
- Pane: `onPaneClick`, `onPaneContextMenu`, `onPaneScroll`, `onPanePointer(Enter|Move|Leave)`
- Connections: `onConnect`, `onConnect(Start|End)`, `onClickConnect(Start|End)`, `onBeforeConnect`, `isValidConnection`
- Reconnect: `onReconnect(Start|End)?`, `onBeforeReconnect` (+ `<EdgeReconnectAnchor>` in custom edges, `reconnectEdge` util)
- Selection: `onSelectionChange`, `onSelectionClick`, `onSelectionContextMenu`, `onSelectionDrag(Start|Stop)?`, `onSelection(Start|End)`
- Viewport: `onMove(Start|End)?` , `onViewportChange` (fires for programmatic changes too)
- Lifecycle: `onInit`, `onDelete`, `onBeforeDelete`, `onNodesDelete`, `onEdgesDelete`, `onFlowError`

## Saving to a server

Pattern A — draft-then-commit (the simpler default; the flow owns the draft):

```tsx
const [serverGraph] = createStore(() => api.loadGraph(), { nodes: [], edges: [] });

<SolidFlow defaultNodes={serverGraph.nodes} defaultEdges={serverGraph.edges}>...</SolidFlow>

// one action batch-commits the whole draft; failed save keeps the draft:
const save = action(function* () {
  yield api.saveGraph(commands.toObject());
  refresh(serverGraph);
});
```

Pattern B — per-mutation sync with an optimistic store (fully supported):

```tsx
const [nodes, setNodes] = createOptimisticNodeStore(() => api.listNodes()); // typed twin of createNodeStore (raw createOptimisticStore works too)
<SolidFlow nodes={nodes} edges={edges}>...</SolidFlow>

// each mutation is its own optimistic action (the part-2 TodoMVC shape):
const addNode = action(function* (node) {
  setNodes((draft) => { draft.push(node); }); // renders mid-action
  yield api.createNode(node);                 // rejected -> flow reverts cleanly
  refresh(nodes);                             // reconcile against server truth
});
// Flow-driven state (selection, drag positions, measurements) lives in
// flow-owned sidecars joined at read time — it survives overlay reverts
// and refresh() reconciles. Persist positions yourself in onNodeDragStop
// (drag writes are flow state, not writes into your optimistic store).
```

Rules for both:
- Never wrap flow-store reads in broad `try/catch` in your computations: `NotReadyError` propagation is load-bearing (it is the server build's re-derive channel). Branch with `isPending()` instead.
- Direct writes to an optimistic store OUTSIDE an action revert immediately (upstream semantics) — user mutations belong inside `action(function* ...)`.

## Gotchas

- Give nodes explicit `width`/`height` for SSR (no DOM to measure) and clean first paint.
- Viewport culling is on by default (CSS tier); `onlyRenderVisibleElements` unmounts off-screen elements; per-element opt-out: `cullable: false`.
- Keep `solid-js` and `@solidjs/web` on the same 2.0.0-rc.x version.
- Plugins: `<Background />`, `<Controls />`, `<MiniMap />`, `<Panel position="...">`, `<NodeToolbar />`, `<NodeResizer />`.
- Full docs: README.md in this package. Examples: playground/ in the repo (https://github.com/dsnchz/solid-flow).
